backtest.evaluation_scope: All 341 common published areas; equal-area MAPE; prices realized and source vintages current. Does not validate the later overlap bridge or prospective accuracy.

approximations: Population-weighted Census2020 PUMA-to-county allocation, matched to February2013 CBSA counties and published2024 SPM menu. Unrepresented county mass remains national. Full-MSA and residual membership approximate confidential CPS geography; neither county assignments nor rent medians are official Census reproductions.
Discrete weighted PUMS medians approximate confidential Census grouped-data median interpolation; topcoding may affect medians.
Four-year overlap subpools retain their product's five-year calibrated weights; the bridge removes their measured vintage shift but does not make future weights known.
Donor households, housing stock and weights remain fixed; baseline assumes zero real rent growth for new cohorts.
Neither Kish support nor OLS/price sensitivities constitute a survey-design variance or forecast confidence interval.
metadata.dollar_adjustment_rule: GRNTP * source ADJHSG / 1000000 exactly once; donor nominal growth divided by its separately declared price path

metadata.index_topcoding_interpretation: Potential sensitivity from local or national medians in any contributing target, anchor or overlap ratio; conservative input flags, not known bias or confidence intervals. Exact published anchors are not PUMS estimates.
metadata.kish_interpretation: Unequal-weight diagnostic; not survey-design effective sample size

price_inputs.forecast_source: Explicit package inflation scenario, not an external forecast
price_inputs.observed_2025_note: BLS M13 annual average uses eleven months; October is missing owing to the lapse in appropriations.

source_vintages.2022: 2018–2022 PUMS with restored December2025 PUMA/weight update

metadata.support_rule: min(unique originals, allocation-expected originals, donor-collapsed Kish)<30; projected windows also flag thin donor support
metadata.survey_year_extraction_rule: First four digits of validated Census housing SERIALNO
metadata.topcode_method: Cohort-specific published state component thresholds applied to nominal values; flags retained in donor copies. Lower bounds use known cash rent, or cash-rent threshold if censored; upper bound unbounded. This conservative diagnostic does not identify uncensored gross rents.
metadata.uncertainty_status: Survey-design uncertainty and forecast intervals are not estimated

sources.derivation_method: Sum Census2020 P.L.94-171 geographic header summary-level140 POP100 by PUMA and county using Census2020 tract-to-PUMA relationship. Validate each state total against summary-level040. Divide each PUMA/county population by its PUMA total. The exact resulting final PUMA-to-area allocation map is committed in area_allocations.

Match Census2020 county codes to February2013 metropolitan CBSA county delineations; recognized published2024 SPM MSA codes use fullMSA approximation, other metropolitan counties use the same-state residualMetro only when published, remaining counties use published same-stateNonmetro. Unrepresented counties retain null area. Join county assignments to population-weighted PUMA/county fractions, aggregate once per PUMA/area and preserve unassigned fractions. The exact resulting final allocation map is committed in area_allocations; suppressed/unsampled CPS state portions remain unresolved.
